t: You're looking at the statue of William Booth, in Tower Hamlets. It commemorates and depicts him. Booth was an English Methodist preacher who, together with his wife Catherine, founded the Salvation Army and became its first General, serving from 1878 until 1912. The movement began in 1865, has a quasi-military structure, and spread from London to many parts of the world. Today it is one of the largest distributors of humanitarian aid.
